subject: Is Effective Radius distance a reflection of detection probability?

messages.author: a43d424e0351a9c7
messages.subject: Is Effective Radius distance a reflection of detection probability?
parts:
Hello,

I'm reviewing a report that summarizes some avian point-count data. One of the figures is a bar graph in which each bar represents one of six bird species of interest. The y-axis is the effective radius (m). My question stems from the Figure's description, which states that the differences in probability of detection of species is expressed as the effective radius. I've never thought of effective radius distance as being directly related to detection probability, so I'm hoping someone here has some insight? Thanks in advance.

Best,
Nick Peterson
